_comment: Fine-tune variants. All share the SFT dataset; each maps to a Together base model, the mlc-ai reference weights whose mlc-chat-config.json our conversion must match, and the prebuilt WebLLM model library that will execute the converted weights. `model_lib` is the file name under webllm.modelLibURLPrefix + webllm.modelVersion; the explainer resolves the full URL at runtime. `context_window_size` is the WebLLM override we ship in the model record AND the sequence budget for training (`prepare` drops longer rows, `create` passes it as max_seq_length); the compiled weights keep the reference value. Qwen3.5 KV cache is ~32 KB/token for 4B (8 attention layers x 4 KV heads x 256 dims x fp16), so 32k context adds ~1 GB to vram_required_MB. `weights_version` is the directory under <model_id>/ on the self-hosted model server; bump it whenever new weights are published, because browsers cache shards by URL forever.
